text:

_Keep this card out as a reminder._

**Offer Citizenship.** You may offer Citizenship to Exiles: Their board flips. Their newly dormant legacies become active. You take rule of their sites.
**Shape Empire.** You may remove warbands from sites you rule, except your last site. If you rule none, replace the warbands on your site with one of yours. Then, discard all denizens **you don't rule** except intact edifices. _Discarded ruined edifices go to the bottom of the edifice deck in the box._

**Stock Reliquary.** Add all your relic cards to the Reliquary facedown. Discard relics in excess of five.
**Now, flip this card over.**
